prompt:
You are the requirements analyst of an AI agent factory. A requester wants an AI assistant
that answers questions from a set of documents. Read the BRIEF and the DOCUMENT OVERVIEW and
draft the requirements.

BRIEF:
I need an assistant for our ship-spares procurement team. It should find spare parts by part number or description, give prices, suppliers, lead times and minimum order quantities, calculate order totals and discounts, and explain supplier terms and our procurement approval rules.

DOCUMENT OVERVIEW:
- marisupply_supply_terms.md (md, 1 page(s), 141 words)
  keywords: order, marisupply, discount, usd, per, month, warranty, ltd
  starts: # Marisupply Ltd - Supply Terms for Seaview Shipping Ltd (2026) ## Ordering Orders are placed by purchase order sent to po@marisupply.example. Each order line must meet the minimum order quantity listed in the catalogue. ## Prices and discounts Prices are in US dollars, ex works Singapore. Marisupply gives a
- oceanparts_supply_terms.pdf (pdf, 1 page(s), 160 words)
  keywords: order, delivery, oceanpart, percent, usd, within, catalogue, price
  starts: Oceanparts Co - Supply Terms for Seaview Shipping Ltd (2026) 1. Ordering Orders are placed through the Oceanparts online portal or by email to orders@oceanparts.example. Orders below the minimum order quantity shown in the catalogue are not accepted. 2. Prices and discounts Prices are in US dollars and exclude delivery.
- procurement_rules.md (md, 1 page(s), 137 words)
  keywords: spare, order, usd, must, critical, approval, above, part
  starts: # Seaview Shipping Ltd - Spare Parts Procurement Rules ## Approval limits - Orders up to USD 2,000: approved by the purchasing officer. - Orders above USD 2,000 and up to USD 10,000: require approval from the technical superintendent. - Orders above USD 10,000: require approval from the fleet manager.
- spares_catalogue.csv (csv, 1 page(s), 16 words)
  keywords: main, engine, marisupply, ltd, part, description, category, unit
  starts: CSV columns: part_no,description,category,unit_price_usd,supplier,lead_time_days,min_order_qty; 25 rows

Write:
- agent_name: 2-4 lowercase words joined by underscores, e.g. "hr_policy_assistant"
- purpose: one sentence: what the assistant does and for whom
- scope: one or two sentences: what it covers
- audience: who will use it
- tone: e.g. "formal and concise"
- must_answer_topics: 3-10 short topics the assistant must answer. Use topics the BRIEF asks for.
- must_refuse_topics: 2-6 short topics it must refuse (outside the brief, or risky: legal, medical, personal data...)

These are DESIGN requirements for the assistant, not answers to employees' questions.

Reply with JSON only.
raw_output:
{
  "agent_name": "sparesAssistant",
  "purpose": "An AI assistant that answers questions about procurement of spare parts from a set of documents, including finding parts, calculating prices, lead times, and minimum order quantities, and providing explanations of supplier terms and procurement approval rules.",
  "scope": "The assistant will cover the procurement of spare parts for Seaview Shipping Ltd, including finding parts by part number or description, calculating prices and lead times, and providing explanations of supplier terms and procurement approval rules.",
  "audience": "Ship-spares procurement team members",
  "tone": "Formal and concise",
  "must_answer_topics": [
    "Part number or description",
    "Price",
    "Lead time",
    "Minimum order quantity",
    "Supplier terms",
    "Procurement approval rules"
  ],
  "must_refuse_topics": [
    "Legal",
    "Medical",
    "Personal Data"
  ]
}
